title: Introducing: The Armin Strom Dual Time GMT Resonance Manufacture Edition, Now with Meteorite Dials
excerpt: The brand’s combination of GMT and resonance returns in a monochromatic stainless steel edition distinguished by natural meteorite dials.
content:
Armin Strom continues to follow its established path, offering limited runs of timepieces that explore variations in finishing and materials. Its Dual Time GMT Resonance now lands in a new edition featuring meteorite dials, building on the collection’s established architecture and bringing a distinctive natural material to a watch that combines two independent time displays with the brand’s signature resonance technology.

The Dual Time GMT Resonance was first introduced in 2018 and revisited in several editions since then. The concept was thoroughly updated in 2024, presented with a compact case and the in-house ARF22 calibre, which brings together two independent regulating systems connected by a patented resonance clutch. The new Meteorite edition retains this movement and its 39mm case, measuring 9.05mm thick and 44.5mm lug-to-lug, here crafted in stainless steel. Sapphire crystals with anti-reflective treatment protect the dial and reveal the movement through the caseback; water-resistance is 50m.

The main novelty is obviously the pair of meteorite dials. Each features its own surface pattern, created by the material’s natural structure. Black azurage chapter rings provide contrast and frame the indications. The applied polished indices receive a rose-gold-coloured coating. The same warm tone is used for the faceted and polished hands. Each dial displays an independent time zone, with its own hours and minutes hands and a day/night indicator. Time in two locations is read separately, with the small day/night discs providing an immediate indication of whether it is daytime or nighttime in each time zone. 

The manual-winding manufacture calibre ARF22 is designed, developed and produced entirely by Armin Strom. It comprises 231 components, measures 34.15mm in diameter and 4.92mm in height, and operates at a frequency of 3.5Hz, or 25,200 vibrations/hour. Power reserve is rated at 42 hours. The movement’s hallmark feature is its two independent regulating systems, each with its own balance wheel. These are connected by Armin Strom’s patented resonance clutch, which enables the oscillations of the two balances to synchronise through the physical phenomenon of resonance. The movement is finished with hand-bevelled and polished edges, black-polished screws, perlage and circular graining.

The watch is worn on a matte grey alligator leather strap with matching stitching; it is closed with a stainless steel pin buckle. Limited to 15 pieces, the Armin Strom Dual Time GMT Resonance Manufacture Edition Meteorite is priced at CHF 105,000.

More information at arminstrom.com.

Technical specifications – Armin Strom Dual Time GMT Resonance Manufacture Edition Meteorite

Case: 39mm diameter x 9.05mm thick, 44.5mm lug to lug – stainless steel – sapphire crystal and caseback with AR treatment – 50m water-resistance

Dial: two meteorite dials – black azurage chapter rings – applied polished rose-gold-coloured indices – polished and blackened steel day/night discs – rose gold-coloured coated, faceted and polished hands

Movement: manufacture calibre ARF22 – manual-winding – 34.15mm x 4.92mm – 40 jewels – 231 components – 25,200vph (3.5Hz) – 42-hour power reserve – two independent regulating systems connected by a patented resonance clutch

Strap: matte grey alligator leather strap with grey stitching – stainless steel pin buckle

Reference: ST26-DT.MT

Availability: limited edition of 15 pieces

Price: CHF 105,000
